definitions.aggregation: Fixed 2026 basket weights; weighted geometric index levels, normalized to 100 in Jan 2015
definitions.drivers: Additive annualised log percentage-point contributions to the change in the analytical basket pace
definitions.history: Current-vintage X-13 estimates; revised history, not archived real-time signals
definitions.direction: Descriptive change outside +/-0.25 pp, not a significance test

columns: Měsíce, měsíční kumulace, měsíce klouzavých průměrů, čtvrtletí, roky

provenance.transformations: Exact selection/pivot of positive NSA 2015-base index levels; no filling, interpolation, rebasing, seasonal or tax adjustment.

weights.definition: fixed 2026 national CPI basket weights from frozen official workbook; analytical weights, not official current chain weights

provenance.use_scope: current-vintage descriptive analysis only; no retrospective forecast revision or historical real-time claim

overlap_revision_audit.policy: Record and permit official overlap revisions for current descriptive analysis only; frozen observations and forecasts stay unchanged.
